now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In season 4, Radcliffe steals it for the Superior, Anton Ivanov.

proposed.text: In season 4, an LMD of May takes the book from the Labyrinth and brings it to Radcliffe, who is working with the Superior, Anton Ivanov.

changes.evidence: In 'The Patriot' (AoS season 4, episode 12), after S.H.I.E.L.D. stops the Watchdogs and Radcliffe from taking the Darkhold out of the Koenigs' Labyrinth, the LMD of May takes the book and brings it to Radcliffe; Ivanov then reads it in episode 13. Radcliffe does not steal it himself.
